mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.module_code, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.path, m.component, m.icon, m.sort, m.visible, m.status, m.create_time, m.update_time FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1
